changelog: 🎨 UI Proportions & Layout Polish: Completely redesigned Antigravity 2.0 PC Suite Sheet, Skills & Plugins Studio, Multi-Agent Studio, and Security Settings so all buttons, tabs, and filter chips render cleanly on a single line without vertical character wrapping.

☁️ Single-File Google Drive Master Backup (JIN_Master_Vault_Backup.zip): Updates a single master archive in-place via PATCH, automatically cleans up old duplicate backup files, enables Auto-Sync by default after chat turns, and adds Restore Local .zip & Save to Downloads for large backups.

🎙️ Maya & Jarvis Real-Time Conversational Voice AI: Speaks back out loud immediately in natural Bangla & English via Neural MP3 TTS (with native Android TTS fallback) while simultaneously executing workspace actions, plus fixes 'শুনছি...' placeholder injection and 'Hello.Hello.' duplicate dictation.

💎 Pure Antigravity 2.0 APK (jin-antigravity-only-v2.2.5-release.apk): 100% isolated to Antigravity (AGY) with all other 5 agents (Claude, DeepSeek, Codex, OpenRouter, OpenCode), Multi-Agent Studio, and API Key dialogs removed.
⚡ Full Multi-Agent Suite APK (jin-termux-v2.2.5-release.apk): Includes all 6 CLI agents, Harness Studio, Jin Fusion, 1-File Google Drive Cloud Vault, and Maya/Jarvis Live Voice AI.
